data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'b-d-y', which means 'to begin' or 'to start'. In Islamic context, it signifies the origin of life, the first step towards a new beginning or the foundation of a journey. This name is often given to girls as a symbol of new beginnings and a fresh start in life. The name Bidayat carries the meaning “Beginning, Origin” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bidayat usually hope their child will grow to embody beginning, origin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
